# DeepMotion

> > DeepMotion is a pioneer in Motion Intelligence, providing AI-powered motion capture and animation tools including Animate 3D for video-to-animation and SayMotion for text-to-motion generation.

DeepMotion offers markerless motion capture technology that transforms video into 3D animation and generates character animations from text prompts. The platform serves game developers, animators, and metaverse creators with REST APIs, companion tools for Roblox and Ready Player Me, and support for industry-standard formats like FBX and BVH.

## Key Topics

- AI Motion Capture
- Animate 3D
- SayMotion
- Video-to-Animation
- Text-to-Animation
- Markerless Tracking

## Core Products

- [Home](https://www.deepmotion.com/home): Homepage for DeepMotion's AI-powered motion capture and animation tools
- [Animate 3D by DeepMotion | AI Motion Capture](https://www.deepmotion.com/animate-3d): Main product page for Animate 3D video-to-animation platform
- [DEEPMOTION - AI Motion Capture & Body Tracking | Companion Tools](https://www.deepmotion.com/companion-tools): Integration tools for Roblox, Avaturn, Ready Player Me, and Blender

## API Reference

- [SayMotion™ by DeepMotion API](https://www.deepmotion.com/saymotion-api): SayMotion REST API for text-to-animation and 3D motion generation
- [Animate 3D API by DeepMotion](https://www.deepmotion.com/animate-3d-api): Animate 3D REST API for video-to-animation and markerless motion capture
